metadata.title: Entrectinib Monotherapy – Adult
metadata.indication: ROS1-positive advanced NSCLC or an eligible adult NTRK gene-fusion-positive solid tumour.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

provenance.source: NCCP 00702 v2 / Lung and tumour-agnostic catalogues

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00702 Version 2. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: ROS1-positive advanced non-small-cell lung cancer not previously treated with a ROS1 inhibitor.

Adult NTRK gene-fusion-positive locally advanced or metastatic solid tumour, or tumour where resection is likely to cause severe morbidity, after no prior NTRK inhibitor and with no satisfactory treatment option.

treatment.duration_text: Continuous until progression or unacceptable toxicity

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No increase above the patient's usual stool frequency or ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Increase of fewer than 4 stools per day above baseline, or mild increase in ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools per day above baseline, or moderate increase in ostomy output; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Increase of 7 or more stools per day above baseline, incontinence, hospital care indicated, or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care activities of daily living.

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Count stools over baseline; assess hydration, continence, hospitalisation, abdominal symptoms and functional impact.

rash_grade.label: Rash/skin toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Papules/pustules covering under 10% body-surface area, with or without pruritus or tenderness.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Papules/pustules covering 10-30% body-surface area with or without symptoms and psychosocial/instrumental-ADL impact, or over 30% with mild symptoms.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Papules/pustules covering over 30% body-surface area with moderate/severe symptoms, limiting self-care ADL, or local superinfection requiring oral antibiotics.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences, or extensive superinfection requiring IV antibiotics.

rash_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess morphology, body-surface area, symptoms, superinfection and functional impact.

pneumonitis_grade.label: Pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Symptomatic; medical intervention indicated; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms; oxygen indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening respiratory compromise; urgent intervention such as ventilatory support required.

pneumonitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess new cough or dyspnoea, oxygen requirement, imaging, infection and alternative causes.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST results (actual values entered; highest ×ULN calculated automatically)
